{{Quote|I have a mission I would like you to undertake, one that is of great import to the continued success of our struggle against the Empire.|Andershan|<ref name="UCD" />}}
'''Andershan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who attained the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He briefed a teams of Rebels on a [[Mission to Tazan|mission]] to destroy the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on [[Tazan]].
